info.title: Payment Gateway API
info.description:
Payment Gateway API lets you accept online payments from your own checkout, receive the result by webhook, and refund when needed. Every endpoint is JSON over HTTPS.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Live** | `http://[$ASSIGN_IP]:8080/v1` |
| **Sandbox** | `http://[$ASSIGN_IP]:8081/v1` |
| **Auth** | HTTP Basic — `accountId` : `secretKey` |
| **Amounts** | Integers in satang — `25000` = ฿250.00 |
| **Webhooks** | HMAC-SHA256 in `GW-Signature` |

### Try it
Pick a server on the right, enter your `accountId` as the username and a **test** secret key as the password, then open any endpoint and press **Test Request**.

Get your `accountId` and a test secret key in the [dashboard](http://68.183.182.9/dashboard/developers/api-keys) under **Developers → API keys**.

New here? Start with the [Quickstart](http://68.183.182.9/docs/quickstart), then read [Authentication](http://68.183.182.9/docs/authentication) and [Errors](http://68.183.182.9/docs/errors).

tags.name: Charges
tags.description: A charge is one attempt to pay. `pending` → `succeeded` | `failed` | `expired`. The last three are final; a failed charge can’t be retried — create a new one.

tags.name: Refunds
tags.description: Return money from a succeeded charge. `pending` → `succeeded` | `failed`.

tags.name: Card tokens
tags.description: Exchange card details for a single-use token from the customer’s device, using your publishable key.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Every webhook is also an event you can list, fetch and redeliver for 30 days.

tags.name: Sandbox
tags.description: Test-only helpers. They exist only on the sandbox host and work with `_test_` keys.

post.description:
Starts a payment from your own checkout. **Call it from your server only.**

The response is the full charge, including a `nextAction` that tells you what your customer needs to do next
(redirect to a bank or 3-D Secure page, or show a PromptPay QR). A `2xx` means the charge was created —
**not** that it was paid. Wait for the `charge.succeeded` webhook before fulfilling the order.

This endpoint never accepts raw card numbers. Exchange card details for a token with
[Create a card token](#tag/card-tokens/POST/client/v1/tokens) first.

In the sandbox, send `GW-Sandbox-Outcome` to choose the result.

get.description: Returns charges, newest first by default. Filter by `status`, `reference` and `paymentMethodType`, and page with the standard list parameters. Use it for daily reconciliation — not for polling a single payment.
Returns one charge. Only poll this as a stopgap until your webhook endpoint is ready; if you must poll, back off between attempts and stop when your order times out.

patch.description: Updates `metadata` only. The amount, payment method and `reference` can’t be changed. Moves `updatedAt`, but never `transactionTime`.

post.description:
Moves a `pending` charge to `expired` right away — use it when your order times out and you need to release stock.
A `charge.expired` webhook follows.

If the customer pays at the same moment, the final result can still be `succeeded`. Always trust the webhook,
and have an automatic refund ready for orders you’ve already closed.

422.description: The object can’t do this in its current state.

value.message: Charge chg_7Qm2xR4 is pending and cannot be refunded yet.

post.description:
Returns money from a `succeeded` charge. The refund starts as `pending`; the webhook tells you the result.

**Rules**
- The charge must be `succeeded`.
- Refundable methods: `card`, `card_installment`, `promptpay`, and `ewallet` payments made with `alipay` or `wechatpay`.
- Partial refunds work only on `card`. Other methods must be refunded in full.
- One refund at a time per charge — another while the first is `pending` returns `422 refund_in_progress`.
- Refunds are paid from your balance — if it isn’t enough, you get `422 insufficient_balance`.

201.description: The refund was created and is `pending`.

422.description: The object can’t do this in its current state.

value.message: Charge chg_7Qm2xR4 is pending and cannot be refunded yet.
A refund on charge chg_8Tn4Wd2 is still processing.
Your balance cannot cover this refund.

get.description: A failed refund has `failure.code` set to `processing_error`. Create a new refund with a new idempotency key. Refunds can’t be edited or cancelled once created.

post.description:
Exchanges card details for a single-use token, valid for 15 minutes.
**Call it directly from your customer’s browser or app** with your publishable key, so card details go
straight to us and never touch your server. Then send the `tok_…` to your server to create the charge.

> Collecting card details in your own form puts you in PCI DSS **SAQ A-EP** scope.

get.description: Events are kept for 30 days. Use them for reconciliation, or to recover events your endpoint missed.

post.description: Sends the event to your current webhook endpoint again.

202.description: Queued for delivery. The event is returned with `deliveryStatus: pending`.

post.description:
**Sandbox only.** Moves a `pending` charge to `succeeded` or `failed` right away, the same as pressing
**Mark as succeeded** or **Mark as failed** on the sandbox payment page. Use it in automated tests.
The matching `charge.succeeded` or `charge.failed` webhook follows.

Create the charge with `GW-Sandbox-Outcome: pending` so it doesn’t complete on its own.
A charge created without `GW-Sandbox-Outcome` went to the payment provider, so it returns `422`.

Safe to retry without an idempotency key: asking for the result the charge already has returns the charge unchanged.

422.description: The object can’t do this in its current state.

value.message: Charge chg_7Qm2xR4 is pending and cannot be refunded yet.

post.description:
A payment succeeded. Fulfil the order.

We `POST` this to your endpoint. Verify the `GW-Signature` header, respond `2xx` within 10 seconds,
and deduplicate by event `id` — events can arrive more than once and out of order.

parameters.name: GW-Signature
parameters.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "{t}.{rawBody}">`. More than one `v1` during secret rotation.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Anything else, or a timeout, is retried up to 10 times with exponential backoff.

Metadata.description: Your own key-value data. Up to 20 keys; values are strings of up to 500 characters. Never put personal or card data here.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Do not parse it.

param.description: The request field that caused the error, when there is one.

requestId.description: Quote this when you contact support.

FailureCode.description: Why a payment failed. See the failure table in the Charges guide.

Failure.description: Why the payment failed. `null` unless `status` is `failed` or `expired`.

networkCode.description: Raw response code from the card network (cards only). For analysis — do not show it to customers.

Customer.description: We recommend a billing address for card payments; it helps approval rates.

token.description: A `tok_…` from the Card tokens endpoint.

terms.description: Plan length in months. Supported terms depend on the card issuer.

promptpay.description: No options today; send `{}` or leave it out.

PaymentMethodInput.description: `type` plus an object of the same name (camelCase) with that method’s options.

NextAction.description: What your customer needs to do next. Check `type`, then read the matching object.

url.description: In the sandbox this points to the sandbox payment page.

imageBase64.description: PNG image of the QR code, base64-encoded.

payload.description: EMVCo payload, if you prefer to render your own QR. In the sandbox this is a URL to the sandbox payment page instead of an EMVCo string.

expiresAt.description: Show a countdown to this time.

amount.description: Amount in the minor unit of the currency (satang for THB). `25000` = ฿250.00.

amountRefunded.description: Sum of succeeded refunds, in satang.

origin.description: Where the charge came from. Always `api` in this release.

transactionTime.description: Set once, the moment the charge first reaches a final status. Never changes after that.

amount.description: Amount in the minor unit of the currency (satang for THB). `25000` = ฿250.00.

device.description: Mobile banking needs `ios` or `android`, otherwise the payment usually can’t complete.

expiresAt.description: When an unpaid charge (QR or redirect) expires. Defaults to 15 minutes after creation.

mode.description: `skip` works only on accounts we’ve approved for it.

amount.description: In satang. Leave it out to refund everything still refundable (`amount − amountRefunded`). Partial refunds work only on `card`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes the request safe to retry. Use a UUID v4 tied to your order. Kept for 24 hours. Strongly recommended on every POST that moves money.

SandboxOutcome.name: GW-Sandbox-Outcome
SandboxOutcome.description: Sandbox only — ignored in live. Simulates the result: `succeeded` (default, after ~5 s), `failed:<failure code>`, `pending` (stays pending until it expires, you expire it, you complete it on the sandbox payment page, or you call `POST /v1/sandbox/charges/{id}/complete`), or `delay:<seconds>`.

PlatformId.name: GW-Platform-Id
PlatformId.description: Platforms only: your platform id, sent with a platform key to act on behalf of a sub-merchant.

From.name: from
From.description: Only objects created at or after this time.

To.name: to
To.description: Only objects created before this time.

BadRequest.description: The body isn’t valid JSON, or a value is missing or invalid (`param` names the field).

value.message: amount must be a positive integer in satang.
The request body is not valid JSON.

Unauthorized.description: Credentials are missing, or the key doesn’t match the account or environment.

Forbidden.description: This key isn’t allowed to do this, or the account or payment method isn’t enabled.

value.message: This key is not allowed to perform this action.
The payment method mobile_banking is not enabled on this account.

NotFound.description: The object doesn’t exist, or belongs to the other environment.

Conflict.description: Idempotency key reused with a different body, or an identical request is still running.

value.message: This Idempotency-Key was used with a different request body.
An identical request is still being processed. Retry shortly.
Too many requests. Retry after 2 seconds.

ServerError.description: Something failed on our side, or the bank or wallet is temporarily unavailable. Retry with the same idempotency key.

value.message: Something went wrong on our side. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
The provider is temporarily unavailable. Retry, or offer another method.

RequestId.description: Unique id of this request. Include it whenever you contact support.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when this response is a replay of an earlier request with the same idempotency key.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

secretKey.description: HTTP Basic auth. **Username:** your `accountId`. **Password:** your secret key (`sk_test_…` or `sk_live_…`). Server-side only. Platforms use a platform key (`plk_…`) with the `GW-Platform-Id` header instead.

publishableKey.description: HTTP Basic auth. **Username:** your `accountId`. **Password:** your publishable key (`pk_test_…` or `pk_live_…`). Safe for browsers and mobile apps; works only with `/client/v1` endpoints.
